title: AlphaDog Styles Unisex Hat for Adults - Dog Breed Line Art, Dad Hat and Trucker Cap
desc:
Wear your best friend. Minimalist continuous line art of your dog's breed on a hat: a portrait printed on the front of the hat.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Style: pick your breed.
2. Color: pick the hat style and color.
3. Add to cart.

HAT STYLES: Dad Hat (Yupoong 6245CM, soft unstructured cotton twill, low profile, adjustable strap), Foam Trucker (OTTO, retro foam front with mesh back, snapback) or Mesh Trucker (Yupoong 6006, 5-panel with mesh back, snapback). One size fits most.

DETAILS
- Printed in the USA, made to order just for you.
- Durable print made to last.
- Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit within the US. Tracking included.

CARE
Spot clean with a damp cloth. Do not machine wash or tumble dry.
bullets: ORIGINAL DOG ART: minimalist line art of your dog's breed by AlphaDog Styles - pick your breed in the Style menu
DESIGN: Line Art with a portrait printed on the front of the hat

HAT STYLES: Dad Hat (Yupoong 6245CM, soft unstructured cotton twill, low profile, adjustable strap), Foam Trucker (OTTO, retro foam front with mesh back, snapback) or Mesh Trucker (Yupoong 6006, 5-panel with mesh back, snapback). One size fits most
MADE TO ORDER IN THE USA: printed just for you, tracking included. Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit
PERFECT GIFT for dog moms, dog dads and every dog lover. Durable print made to last
fabric: cotton twill (foam/mesh trucker styles include polyester)
